package analysis

import (
 "context"
 "fmt"
 "net/http"
 "net/http/httptest"
 "strings"
 "sync/atomic"
 "testing"
 "time"

 "github.com/Savio09/gittok-ios-backend/internal/githubclient"
)

// All barriers are channels; a timeout only bounds a broken test.
type reviewHTTP struct {
 metadata, refs, trees atomic.Int32
 treeStarted, treeRelease chan struct{}
 metadataStarted, metadataRelease chan struct{}
 gateMetadata atomic.Bool
}
func reviewServer(t *testing.T) (*reviewHTTP, *Service) {
 t.Helper()
 h := &reviewHTTP{treeStarted: make(chan struct{}), treeRelease: make(chan struct{}), metadataStarted:make(chan struct{},128),metadataRelease:make(chan struct{})}
 srv := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter,r *http.Request) {
  switch {
  case strings.Contains(r.URL.Path,"/commits/"):
   h.refs.Add(1); fmt.Fprint(w,`{"sha":"0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef01234567"}`)
  case strings.Contains(r.URL.Path,"/git/trees/"):
   if h.trees.Add(1)==1 {close(h.treeStarted); <-h.treeRelease};fmt.Fprint(w,`{"tree":[],"truncated":false}`)
  case r.URL.Path=="/repos/o/r":
   h.metadata.Add(1)
   if h.gateMetadata.Load() { h.metadataStarted<-struct{}{}; <-h.metadataRelease }
   fmt.Fprint(w,`{"id":7,"owner":{"login":"o"},"name":"r","full_name":"o/r","private":false,"default_branch":"main"}`)
  default: t.Errorf("unexpected HTTP request %s",r.URL);w.WriteHeader(404)
  }
 }))
 t.Cleanup(srv.Close)
 s:=NewPublicService(githubclient.WithBaseURL(srv.URL),githubclient.WithMaxRetries(0))
 c,err:=OpenPreviewCache(t.TempDir(),DefaultCacheLimits(),time.Now);if err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)};s.UseCache(c)
 return h,s
}
func reviewStart(s *Service) <-chan error {done:=make(chan error,1);go func(){_,err:=s.Preview(context.Background(),"o","r");done<-err}();return done}

func TestSwarmAdmissionBoundsPreAdmissionHTTP(t *testing.T) {
 h,s:=reviewServer(t)
 s.UseAdmission(AdmissionLimits{MaxActive:1,MaxPerKey:1,MaxWaiters:1,Deadline:30*time.Second})
 first:=reviewStart(s);<-h.treeStarted
 h.gateMetadata.Store(true)
 const n=80
 outs:=make([]<-chan error,n)
 for i:=range outs {outs[i]=reviewStart(s)}
 for range n {<-h.metadataStarted}
 s.flights.mu.Lock();active,waiters:=s.flights.active,s.flights.waiters;s.flights.mu.Unlock()
 t.Logf("saturated limits: active=%d waiters=%d; %d additional metadata HTTP requests are simultaneously blocked upstream",active,waiters,h.metadata.Load()-1)
 h.gateMetadata.Store(false);close(h.metadataRelease)
 for _,out:=range outs {if err:=<-out;err!=ErrOverloaded {t.Errorf("excess caller err=%v",err)}}
 close(h.treeRelease);if err:=<-first;err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 if got:=h.metadata.Load()-2;got>1 {t.Errorf("admission limit=1 allowed %d extra upstream visibility requests",got)}
}

// preview.go's overlay inserts this barrier immediately after the outer cache
// lookup misses. No acquisition/cache behavior is changed by instrumentation.
var cacheMissBarrier func()

func TestSwarmCacheMissRechecksAfterWinningFlight(t *testing.T) {
 h,s:=reviewServer(t)
 first:=reviewStart(s);<-h.treeStarted
 missEntered,allowMiss:=make(chan struct{}),make(chan struct{})
 cacheMissBarrier=func(){close(missEntered);<-allowMiss}
 second:=reviewStart(s);<-missEntered
 close(h.treeRelease)
 if err:=<-first;err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)} // A has stored and retired its flight.
 close(allowMiss)
 if err:=<-second;err!=nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 cacheMissBarrier=nil
 t.Logf("HTTP endpoint counts: metadata=%d refs=%d trees=%d",h.metadata.Load(),h.refs.Load(),h.trees.Load())
 if got:=h.trees.Load();got!=1 {t.Errorf("two simultaneous same-key misses ran %d acquisitions despite first storing a valid cache entry",got)}
}
